title: Two More Minutes
can_do: 需要从喜欢的活动转场时，请求一小段明确的时间并按约定行动。
trigger: Mom says it is time to leave for the park while the child's drawing still lacks its sun, so he asks for two more minutes to finish the rays.
setting: Finishing a drawing at home before leaving for the park.
essential_props: one drawing with its yellow crayon

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: It's time to leave for the park.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Can I have two more minutes? My sun is not done yet.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: What does the sun still need?

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Two minutes for the sun, then we really go.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Okay. Sun first, then we go.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Deal. I'll wait at the door.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Ready! Look, the sun is smiling.

replay_cards.title: Leave the playground
replay_cards.change: Ask for one final slide, but Dad initially thinks Child wants more open-ended play
replay_cards.challenge: Child requests one final slide. When Dad checks whether he means more playtime, Child repairs, "I mean one final slide, then I'll come." Dad agrees to that one turn; Child takes it and meets him at the gate.

replay_cards.title: Pause the puzzle
replay_cards.change: Ask for two minutes to place the last three pieces
replay_cards.challenge: Mom sets the timer; finish or pause when it rings and come to the table

parent_support: Allow up to two minutes only when the schedule permits; agree on one small visible finish point.
The child can finish early. Once the sun is done, acknowledge it and leave together without another task or a language test.
